items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (surge damaged, replaced like-for-like)
items.rationale: The living-room unit is a fixed, permanently wired technical installation serving the building, damaged by insured overvoltage (2.3.3). Replacement like-for-like is covered (7.1.9), and the unit is not within 5m of a cooking appliance, so the kitchen exclusion (2.3.10(c)) does not apply. Reference Case 15 (speaker system, surge damaged) and Case 33 (laptop replacement) suggest a fair threshold for such fixed installations.

items.description: Air conditioning unit - kitchen (wall-mounted a couple of metres from the hob)
items.rationale: Although the kitchen unit is a fixed installation, 2.3.10(c) specifically excludes overvoltage damage to climate-control equipment installed within 5m of a cooking appliance unless a kitchen climate endorsement is present (not taken here). The unit is 'a couple of metres' from the hob, so exclusion applies: t = 0.

Installation labour for the living-room unit is an ancillary charge (1.3, 7.1.11) and is indemnified as the principal item is covered. Reference Case 33 (diagnostic/installation) and Case 15 (installation) suggest a moderate threshold.
Ancillary charge for a principal item that is excluded (see item 2). Per 7.1.11, ancillary charges follow the principal: t = 0.

items.description: Floor console (equivalent stand for the living-room unit)
items.rationale: The floor console is a fixed support required for the living-room unit (7.1.9b), and the old one was damaged and could not be reused. Covered as part of the like-for-like replacement.

Freight shipping is an ancillary charge (1.3, 7.1.11) and is indemnified only for the covered principal item (living-room unit). As the invoice does not split the charge, only half is indemnified (apportioned by value, 7.1.11). Reference Case 15 (shipping) and Case 33 (delivery) suggest a low threshold.
